। yEstu dravyaM cikIrzyate guRaH tatra pratIyeta iti, tatra apUrvArTatA vyAvarttitA, dfzwaprayojanAnAmA KyAtAnAm । iha tu sarvezAmeva SezARAM lakzaRamucyate” Sava॰ BA॰ । tasya lakzyARi tatrAha “dravyaguRasaMskArezu vAdariH” sU॰ “vAdarirAcAryaH atra dravyaguRasaMskArezveva SezaSabdaH iti mene, na yAgaPalapuruzezu! dravyaM kriyArTaM, yadi prayojanavatI kriyA, vyaktaM sA dravyeRa nirvarttayitavyA, tasyA niMrvfttirdravyAdfte na Bavati iti tannirvfttaye dravyamezitavyaM Bavati, tasmAt kriyArTaM dravyam । guRaH Saknoti viSizwaM dravyaM coditaM lakzayitum, lakzitena ca tena prayojanam, viSizwasya kriyAsADanatvAt, tasmAt so'pi dravyadvAreRa kriyAyA upakaroti iti kriyArTa eva । saMskAro nAma sa Bavati, yasmin jAte padArTo mavati yogyaH kasyacit arTasya, tenApi kriyAyAM karttavyAyAM prayojanam iti so'pi parArTaH । tasmAt dravyaguRasaMskArAH parArTatvAt SezaBUtAH । na tu yAgaPalapuruzAH । yAgaH tAvat karttavyaH puruzasya, na hi, tasmin nirvarttite kiYcit aparamasti karttavyam । sa hi puruzArTaH, yadanyat dravyAdi, tat tadarTaM tasya SezaBUtam, sa tu na kiYcidaBinirvarttayitum kriyate । Palamapi na tena kriyate, tasmita tu kfte svayameva tat Bavati । tasmin kfte Palamasya Bavati pftyetAvat gamyate, nAsti Sabdo yAgena kriyate Palamiti । tasmAt yAgo na SezaBUtaH kasyacit arTasya । Palamapi na puruza pratyupadiSyate, yaH svargaM kAmayate, sa yAgaM kuryyAdityetAvat SabdenIpadiSyate, nAtmanaH parasya vA iti, svargaM pratIcCAmAtreRa svarBakAmaH iti Bavati, tasmAt puruzaM prati guRaBAvena na SrUyate svargaH, tasmAt so'pi na SezaBUtaH । na cet PalayAgO guRaBAvena codyete, kasya puruzaH praDAnaBUtI Bavati? pratyakzaScAsya dravyatvAt karma prati guRaBaBAvaH । tasmAt dravyaguRasaMskArezveza SezaBAvaM vAdarirmene” Saba॰ BA॰ । “karmARyapi jEminiH, PalArTatvAt” sU॰ “jEministu svalvAScAryyaH karmARyapi SezaBUtAni manyate a, na vAdaririvAvaDAraRAmanumene, sa hi dadarSa, yAgaH karttavyatayA codyate, PalakAmasya tu tatsADanopAvatvena iti । evaM Sruto'rTaH parigfhIto Bavizyati, arTavAMScopadeSaH । etaBevArTaM zazWe'DyAye sUtrEreva sADayizyati । iha tu tatsidDenEva PalArTatvena SezaBAvaM yAgasyApAdayati sma । tasmAt anavaDAraRA dravyaguRasaMskArAH SezaBUtAH yAgo'pi SezaBUtaH Palamprati” BA॰ । “PalaM ca puruzArTatvAt” sU॰ । “Palamapi puruzaM pratyupadiSyate, yaH, svargo me Bavet ityevaM kAmayate, tasya yAgaH na yaH svargaH, sa AtmAnaM laBeta iti । AtmanepadaprayogAt, karttraBiprAye etat Bavati, kriyAPalamanuBavet kaTaM puruzaH? iti yAgaH prayujyate । tasmAt PalaM puruzArTaM yAgAt SrUyate nAtmanirvfttyarTam । tasmAt SezaBUtam iti” BA॰ । “puruzaSca karmArTatvAt” sf॰ । “puruzo'pyOdambarIsamBAnAdizu guRaBUtaH SrUyate । tasmAt anavaDAraRA ezA, dravyaguRasaMskArezu SezatvaM vArdarirmene iti” । “aTa idAnImatrAnuSayavAn vfttikAraH pariniScikAya, dravyaguRasaMskArezveva niyato yajimprati SezaBAvaH, Apekzika itarezAm । yAgasya dravyamprati praDAnaBAvaH, Palamprati guRaBAvaH, Palasya yAgamprati prADAnyam, puruzamprati guRatA, puruzasya Palamprati praDAnatA, OdumbarIsammAnAdi prati guRatvam tasmAt sammatA avaGAraRA, dravyaguRasaMskArA yAgamprati niyamatA guRaBUtA eva” BA॰ kasyacit SezarakzaRanizeDo yaTA “fRaSezaM cAgniSezaM SatruSezaM taTEva ca । punaHpunaH pravardDante tasmAt SezaM na kArayet” garuqapu॰ “prasAdAnnijanirmAlyadAne Sezeti kIrttitA” viSvokte KAminA prasAdadatte 8 mAlye strI “taTeti SezAmiva BarturAjYAm” kumAraH ।
m: शेष &c. See p. 1088, col. 3.

शेष m. n. (fr. √ 2. शिष्) remainder, that which remains or is left, leavings, residue (pl. ‘all the others’), surplus, balance, the rest (शेषे loc. ‘for the rest’, ‘in all other cases’; शेषे रात्रौ, ‘during the rest of the night’; मम शेषम् अस्ति, ‘there remains something to happen to me’)

that which has to be supplied (e.g. any word or words which have been omitted in a sentence; इति शेषः, ‘so it was left to be supplied’, a phrase commonly used by Comm. in supplying any words necessary to elucidate the text)
that which is saved or spared or allowed to escape (nom. with √ अस्, or √ भू, ‘to be spared’; शेषं-√ कृ, ‘to spare’, ‘allow to escape’; शेषम् अवाप् ‘to escape’), Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.
remaining (used as an adj. at the end of adj. comp. [f(आ). ], cf. कथा-श्˚, कृत्य-श्˚), AitBr. &c. &c.

remaining out of or from, left from (with abl. or loc., e.g. प्रयातेभ्यो ये शेषाः, ‘the persons left out of those who had departed’; but mostly ifc. after a pp. in comp., e.g. भुक्त-शेष, ‘remaining from a meal’, ‘remnant of food’; हत-शेषाः, ‘those left out of the slain’, ‘the survivors’ &c.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
end, issue, conclusion, finish, result, RV. 77, 15
last, last-mentioned, Rājat.
a supplement, appendix, Nir. iii, 13
a keepsake, token of remembrance, Daś.
secondary matter, accident, KātyŚr., Sch.
death, destruction, W.
effect.

शेष m. N. of a celebrated mythological thousand-headed serpent regarded as the emblem of eternity (whence he is also called An-anta, ‘the infinite’; in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa he and the serpents Vāsuki and Takṣaka are described as sons of Kadru, but in one place Śeṣa alone is called king of the Nāgas or snakes inhabiting Pātāla, while elsewhere Vāsuki also is described as king of the Nagas and Takṣaka of the serpents; the thousand headed Śeṣa is sometimes represented as forming the couch and canopy of Viṣṇu whilst sleeping during the intervals of creation, sometimes as supporting the seven Pātālas with the seven regions above them and therefore the entire world ; he is said to have taught astronomy to Garga; according to some legends he became incarnate in Bala-rāma q.v.), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. &c. (RTL. 105; 112; 232 n. 1)
N. of one of the Prajā-patis, R.; VP.
of a Muni, MW.
(also with आचार्य, दीक्षित, शास्त्रिन् &c.) of various authors (cf. below)
of one of the mythical elephants that support the earth, L.
a kind of metre, L.
शेष n. See above.
a: शेष — a. [शिस्-अच्] Remaining, rest, all the other; न्यषोधि शेषोप्यनुयायिवर्गः R. 2. 4, 4. 64, 10. 29; Me. 30, 87; रंभे निर्बर्त्यतां शेषो विधिः V. 5; शेषान् मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा Me. 110; Ms. 3. 47; Ku. 2. 44; oft. at the end of comp. in this sense; भक्षितशेष, आलेख्यशेष &c. --षः --षं 1 (a) Remainder, rest, residue; ऋणशेषोग्निशेषश्च व्याधिशेषस्तथैव च . पुनश्च वर्धते यस्मात्तस्माच्छेषं न कारयेत् Chāṇ. 40; अध्वशेष Me. 38; प्रतिकारविधानमायुषः सति शेषं हि फलाय कल्पते R. 8. 40; so शेषे वयसः समागतो मृत्युः Bv. 4. 30; त्रिपागशेष Ku. 5. 57; वाक्यशेषः V. 3. &c. (b) Surplus, balance. --2 Anything left out or omitted to be said; (इति शेषः is often used by commentators in supplying an ellipsis or words necessary to complete the construction). --3 Escape, salvation, respite. --षः 1 Result, effect. --2 End, termination, conclusion. --3 Death, destruction. --4 N. of a celebrated serpent, said to have one thousand heads, and represented as forming the couch of Viṣṇu or as supporting the entire world on his head; किं शेषस्य भरव्यथा न वपुषि क्ष्मां न क्षिपत्येष यत् Mu. 2. 18, Ku. 3. 13; R. 10. 13. --5 N. of Balarāma (supposed to be an incarnation of Śeṣa). --6 An elephant. --षा The remains of flowers or other offerings made to an idol and distributed among the worshippers as a holy relique; तथोति शेषामिव भर्तुराज्ञामादाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे Ku. 3. 22, Ś. 3. --षं The remnants of food, remains of an offering. (शेषे is used adverbially in the sense of {1} at last, finally. --2 in other cases; as in शेषे षष्ठी). --Comp. --अन्नं leavings of food. --अवस्था old age. --कालः the time of death. --जातिः f. assimilation of residues. --भागः the remainder. --भोजनं the eating of leavings. --रात्रिः the last watch of the night. --शयनः, --शायिन् m. epithets of Viṣṇu.

शेष—विस्तार-पाण्डु mfn. pale in its remaining surface (said of a cloud), Megh.
शेषिन् mfn. having (little) remainder (i.e. constituting the ‘chief matter’ or ‘main point’), Sarvad.
शेष्य mfn. to be left or ignored or neglected, Kathās.
